content:
Leaker Evan Blass has just posted online three color options claimed to be for the iPhone Ultra, and surprisingly one of them is red.

Update: Mark Gurman posted on X claiming the iPhone Ultra will not have a red version, directly refuting Blass's claim. The original report is as follows.

Evan Blass claims iPhone Ultra may come in red

Apple's launch event has been officially scheduled for September 9, and rumors about the new generation flagship iPhone continue to emerge, with the latest involving the color options for the foldable iPhone Ultra.

The market has largely agreed that the iPhone 18 Pro will come in deep cherry/wine red, light blue, silver, and possibly space gray.

However, rumors suggest the iPhone Ultra may only be available in black and white at launch, or even white only.

But leaker Evan Blass recently posted on X claiming that the iPhone Ultra will also come in a red version.

The image above appears to be AI-generated, for example the status bar is inconsistent with iOS 27 and still uses the older iOS 26 battery icon design.

However, even if the image is very likely AI-generated, it does not necessarily mean the color information within it is incorrect.

We are skeptical about this, as there have been no credible rumors previously suggesting the iPhone Ultra would offer a red version. It would also seem unusual for both flagship models to have a red option, so this rumor should be treated with caution.

Regardless of what Apple has prepared, we'll find out in just two more weeks.

What do you think of the rumored color options for the iPhone Ultra? Let us know in the comments.
